_doc: Uncovered units (statements never executed + branches taken in only one direction + lines excluded by a `# pragma: no cover`) per hard-rule surface, as measured by the FULL suite under `coverage run`. The gate is an EQUALITY: more is a regression, less is an improvement that must be locked in here. Written only by `make coverage-ratchet-accept`, which refuses to grow a number without a RAISED_BUDGETS waiver in scripts/check_coverage_ratchet.py. See that file's docstring for why this is a count per area and not a repo-wide percentage.
